title: Canonical derived tensor pullback for the global ringed-space map
statement: For every scheme X let A=Γ(X,O_X), Y=(pt,A) be globalSectionsPoint X and p=toGlobalSectionsPoint X. Under the evaluation equivalence e:Mod(O_Y)≃Mod(A), ordinary p* is inverse image followed by change of rings along p-sharp, on objects and morphisms as prescribed. There exist this additive strong monoidal functor P:Mod(A)→Mod(O_X), its evaluation adjunction P⊣Γ, an absolute total left-derived functor L with comparison α (invertible on K-flat complexes), and canonical bifunctorial isomorphisms δ_{E,F}:L(E tensor_A^L F)≅LE tensor_O_X^L LF. The ordinary tensor constraint is normalized by P.μ followed by P of the concrete tensor-of-sections map and the evaluation counit = the tensor of the two counits. On K-flat representatives δ is normalized by the totalized inverse ordinary tensor constraint and α: L(μ_Qh) followed by α at K tensor M followed by Qh(δ_P,total) equals δ_{QhK,QhM} followed by α_K tensor α_M followed by μ_Qh at PK,PM. The notions are those of def-pc-global-derived-rhom, lem-pc-ringed-space-tensor-pullback-underived, lem-pc-ringed-space-tensor-pullback-absolute, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure and lem-sc-module-cup-naive-map-chain. No flatness, finiteness or boundedness condition on X or the derived objects is imposed.

proof.text: Obtain ordinary global pullback data by transport of the point-evaluation equivalence and the concrete pullback adjunction, including the counit-normalized tensor constraint.

Apply the derived tensor comparison to this e and P with their prescribed object and morphism equations. Package the ordinary counit equation together with L, α, its absolute derivation and K-flat invertibility, and δ with naturality and normalization. The raw normalization equation is definitionally moduleCup_globalTensorDiagram.

theorem globalRingedSpace_derivedTensor_pullback_comparison :
    ∃ (e : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (globalSectionsPoint X)) ≌
        ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
      (_ : Nonempty (e.functor ≅ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (globalSectionsPoint X)))
      (P : ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (h : ∀ M, P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
          X.toRingedSpace.sheaf (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf
            ⟨(toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
          (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M)))
      (_ : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N), P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫
        SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
          (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            X.toRingedSpace.sheaf (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf
              ⟨(toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.c⟩)
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M))
          (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap (toGlobalSectionsPoint X).hom.base
            (globalSectionsPoint X).sheaf (e.inverse.obj M) (e.inverse.map a)) ≫
          eqToHom (h N).symm)
      (hadd : P.Additive) (mon : P.Monoidal)
      (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace),
      letI := hadd
      letI := mon
      letI := adj.isLeftAdjoint
      (∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace),
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ P
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj M)
            ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).obj N) ≫
          P.map (moduleCup_sectionTensorMap X M N) ≫ adj.counit.app (M ⊗ N) =
        adj.counit.app M ⊗ₘ adj.counit.app N) ∧
      ∃ (L : DerivedCategory
          (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
        (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
          P.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
        L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
        (∀ H : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ⥤
            DerivedCategory
              (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))),
          (L ⋙ H).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
            ((Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight α H)
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ∧
        (∀ K : CochainComplex
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) ℤ,
          (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat K →
            IsIso (α.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj K))) ∧
        ∃ δ : ∀ A B, L.obj (A ⊗ B) ≅ L.obj A ⊗ L.obj B,
          (∀ A A' B B' (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B'),
            L.map (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ (δ A' B').hom =
              (δ A B).hom ≫ (L.map f ⊗ₘ L.map g)) ∧
          ∀ K M : CochainComplex
              (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) ℤ,
            (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat K →
            (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat M →
              moduleCup_globalTensorDiagram X P L α δ
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj K)
                ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj M)
